known_P30_exception.reader_whole_file_limit: This old reader file is observed to inspect its named entry. Its whole-file hash is not promoted to a pre-existing binding when absent from the requested inventories.
known_P30_exception.scope: Only the already-documented entries/7 historical assertion is retained as a known non-PASS exception; any new mismatch still stops. The current reader whole-file observation is newly pinned for this audit, not retroactively vouched for by older inventories.

fresh_audit_requirements.A: Fresh primary/authoritative browsing trail for every registered bibliography item. No programmatic bibliographic API client was requested.
fresh_audit_requirements.B: All registered current citation contexts, using the exact accessible or retained source material with its real evidence limit.
fresh_audit_requirements.C: All registered current data/quantitative surfaces, figure/table trace checks and experiment declaration/provenance checks. No new research execution.
fresh_audit_requirements.D: At least 50% of declared eligible prose paragraphs, every major section, and 100% of revision-added or substantively changed prose paragraphs; report denominator/selection and actual searches.
fresh_audit_requirements.E: Fresh semantic current-draft Claim Registry and 100% of that registered population; official coverage build/replay and complete official evidence-row build/replay. Semantic extraction completeness remains not_machine_detectable.
fresh_audit_requirements.E6: Every round and claim-bearing operation of the exact current continuous bundle is semantically inspected against its actual contemporary authorization. Keep historical findings/restoration evidence and do not substitute the latest pair for the chain.
fresh_audit_requirements.failure_modes: All seven named modes with source-bound evidence and mandatory handling of blocking observations.
fresh_audit_requirements.compliance: Fresh Schema12-compatible non-SR principles-only reporting assessment; not an author-fact attestation.

execution_ownership.root: P29 and P32 audit work; root integration, shared input protection and final handoff/schema validation; no manuscript patching.
execution_ownership.official_local_artifact_calls: Each paper owner performs its inspected official bundle, Claim Registry coverage and evidence-row build/replay exactly once per unchanged valid input. Root consumes receipts and performs final report/handoff/Schema12 validation once; do not duplicate paper-level success without a changed input or specific concern.

historical_record_handling: Old PASS/FAIL/reader/preview/patch/bundle/author facts and prior audits are preserved. Prior reports may be consulted for the required supplementary closure comparison only after fresh substantive judgments, not used as the source of a new verdict.

stop_and_nonrelease.new_mismatch_or_official_failure: Stop affected execution and retain original command/input/output; request direction for a real protected-workflow failure, with no lock or receipt repair.
stop_and_nonrelease.known_reader_exception: Only the exact old P30 entries/7 exception described here is already acknowledged as retained and non-PASS.
